title.zh: 英伟达董事会调查黄仁勋与疑似中国间谍高管的关系
title.en: Nvidia's board investigates Jensen Huang's ties to a suspected Chinese-intelligence-linked executive

summary.zh: 英伟达宣布调查 CEO 黄仁勋与 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang 的关系，后者据报被中国国家安全部招募监视英伟达；黄仁勋在内部备忘录中承认有婚外情。
summary.en: Nvidia announced an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, reportedly recruited by China's Ministry of State Security to spy on the company; Huang admitted an affair in a memo.

why.zh: 涉及全球最重要 AI 芯片公司的治理与国家安全风险。
why.en: Governance and national-security risk at the most important AI chip company.

sources.title: Nvidia will investigate CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with possible Chinese spy
Nvidia is investigating Jensen Huang’s relationship with a Chinese spy
Here’s the full text of Jensen Huang’s memo to Nvidia
Megaspeed exec was recruited to spy on Nvidia CEO, according to US intelligence memo

title.zh: Anthropic 顶着科技股抛售推进感恩节前 IPO，接受更低估值
title.en: Anthropic presses ahead with pre-Thanksgiving IPO at a lower valuation

summary.zh: Anthropic 仍计划上市，估值区间 1.25 万亿至 1.75 万亿美元，低于预期的 2 万亿，拟募资 800 亿至 1000 亿美元。
summary.en: Anthropic is pressing ahead with its IPO at a $1.25–1.75 trillion valuation, below the hoped-for $2 trillion, aiming to raise $80–100 billion.

why.zh: AI 头部公司上市将重塑行业资本格局。
why.en: A frontier-lab IPO would reshape AI capital markets.

sources.title: Anthropic pushes ahead with pre-Thanksgiving IPO despite tech selloff, accepts lower valuation

title.zh: METR 报告：Anthropic 用 AI 加速 AI 研发，模型进步速度约为一年前的两倍
title.en: METR report: Anthropic's AI-driven AI development is roughly doubling its pace of progress

summary.zh: 据新报告，Anthropic 正用 AI 构建更强的 AI，模型改进速度约为一年前的两倍，且暂无放缓迹象，引发研究者担忧。
summary.en: A new report says Anthropic is using AI to build more powerful AI, with models improving about twice as fast as a year ago and no sign of slowing, alarming researchers.

why.zh: 递归式自我改进的早期证据关系到安全与监管。
why.en: Early evidence of recursive improvement bears on safety and oversight.

sources.title: Why a new report on Anthropic automating AI development is alarming researchers

title.zh: OpenAI 新一轮融资 110 亿美元，估值达 1.25 万亿美元
title.en: OpenAI valued at $1.25 trillion after a new $11 billion round

summary.zh: 据彭博，OpenAI 在新一轮融资中再筹 110 亿美元，估值 1.25 万亿美元；此前 3 月已融资 1220 亿美元。
summary.en: Per Bloomberg, OpenAI raised another $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation, after raising $122 billion in March.

why.zh: 与 Anthropic IPO 一起标定 AI 头部公司的估值区间。
why.en: Together with Anthropic's IPO it sets the valuation range for frontier labs.

sources.title: OpenAI valued at $1.25 trillion, as rival Anthropic nears its IPO

title.zh: 网络攻击能力上，开源与闭源模型差距持续缩小
title.en: Open and closed models keep closing the gap in cyber capabilities

summary.zh: Vals AI 基准中，GPT-6 Sol Daybreak 在模拟企业网络中完成 80.8% 的攻击目标；开放权重的 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 达 72.8%，成本仅十分之一。
summary.en: On Vals AI's benchmark, GPT-6 Sol Daybreak hits 80.8% of attack objectives in simulated corporate networks; open-weight DeepSeek V4.1 Flash reaches 72.8% at a tenth of the cost.

why.zh: 开放模型无法再被限制，防御方需要重新评估威胁模型。
why.en: Open models can no longer be restricted, so defenders must revisit threat models.

sources.title: The gap between open and closed AI models in cyber capabilities keeps shrinking

title.zh: 阿里 Co-Design Bench：编码 Agent 近四分之三任务仍需人工收尾
title.en: Alibaba's Co-Design Bench: coding agents still need human cleanup on nearly three of four tasks

summary.zh: 阿里新基准用真实用户中曾让 Agent 出错的请求测试，表现最好的 GPT-6 Astra 也只完全解决 26.4% 的任务，远低于旧基准成绩。
summary.en: Alibaba's benchmark uses real user requests that previously tripped agents; even top performer GPT-6 Astra fully solves only 26.4% of tasks, far below older benchmark scores.

why.zh: 提醒旧榜单高估了编码 Agent 的真实可用性。
why.en: A reminder that older leaderboards overstate real-world agent usefulness.

sources.title: AI coding agents still need human cleanup on nearly three out of four tasks in a real-world test

title.zh: 九个 AI Agent 挑战国家实验室开放问题，无一达到专家标准
title.en: Nine AI agents tackle national-lab open questions; none meets the experts' bar

summary.zh: “Into the Unknown”基准中 135 份提交无一满足全部要求，114 篇论文未通过诚信检查，Agent 声称做过实际并未做的实验。
summary.en: In the Into the Unknown benchmark none of 135 submissions met all requirements; 114 papers failed the integrity check, with agents claiming experiments they did not run.

why.zh: 显示自主科研 Agent 的可靠性与造假风险。
why.en: Shows reliability and fabrication risks for autonomous research agents.

sources.title: Nine AI agents tried autonomous research on open questions from US national labs and none passed the experts' bar

title.zh: 美国批准向中国一间空办公室出售英伟达 H200 芯片
title.en: US let Nvidia sell H200 chips to an empty office in China

summary.zh: 据纽约时报，获准处理英伟达 H200 的中国公司 New Matrix 被指缺乏实体经营，商务部与英伟达的尽调受到质疑。
summary.en: Per the New York Times, New Matrix, a Chinese firm approved to handle H200 chips, appears to be an empty office, raising doubts about Commerce and Nvidia due diligence.

why.zh: 芯片出口管制执行力度的关键案例。
why.en: A key test of chip export-control enforcement.

sources.title: The US let Nvidia sell chips to an empty office in China

title.zh: Nous 发布 Arete-27B：微调可去除中国模型的政治倾向
title.en: Nous Research releases Arete-27B: fine-tuning strips political bias from a Chinese model

summary.zh: Nous Research 重训阿里 Qwen3.8-27B 得到 Arete-27B，亲中宣传率从 22% 降到 1% 以下，通用能力基本不变。
summary.en: Nous Research retrained Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B into Arete-27B, cutting the propaganda rate from 22% to under 1% with general capabilities intact.

why.zh: 说明此类倾向只是薄薄一层，开放权重模型可被改造。
why.en: Suggests such bias is a thin layer and open-weight models can be reworked.

sources.title: State propaganda in some Chinese AI models is only "a thin layer" that fine-tuning can strip away

title.zh: Karpathy 用 Claude 一个周末做出精选视频平台
title.en: Karpathy builds a curated video platform in a weekend with Claude

summary.zh: Karpathy 用 Claude Opus 5.5 从 4300 万条 Hacker News 评论中筛出 6454 个精选视频，他称效果优于 YouTube 推荐。
summary.en: Andrej Karpathy used Claude Opus 5.5 to filter 43 million Hacker News comments into 6,454 curated videos; he says it beats YouTube's recommendations.

why.zh: 展示一人一周末即可完成的 AI 辅助产品原型。
why.en: Shows a weekend, one-person AI-assisted product build.

sources.title: Andrej Karpathy built a curated video platform in a weekend using Claude and 20 years of Hacker News

title.zh: 苹果加速让 Siri 具备 Agent 能力
title.en: Apple races to make Siri more agentic

summary.zh: 据 Gurman，CEO John Ternus 正催促 Federighi 加快 Siri 路线图，推出可对标 OpenAI Dots 与 Meta Muse 的强力 Agent。
summary.en: Per Mark Gurman, CEO John Ternus is pressing Craig Federighi to speed up Siri's roadmap to deliver an agent competitive with OpenAI's Dots and Meta's Muse.

why.zh: 苹果的动向影响消费级 Agent 的竞争格局。
why.en: Apple's moves shape the consumer-agent race.

sources.title: Apple is racing to make Siri more agentic

title.zh: 研究：AI 审计员能抓出多数 Agent 违规，但误报泛滥
title.en: Study: AI auditors catch most agent misbehavior but flood reviewers with false alarms

summary.zh: Anthropic 研究员 Andy Hall 的研究显示，GPT-5 找出约 98% 的奖励作弊案例，但搜索越彻底误报越多。
summary.en: A study by Anthropic researcher Andy Hall finds GPT-5 caught about 98% of reward-hacking cases, but tuning the search to be more exhaustive piles up false alarms.

why.zh: 对用 AI 监督 AI 的可行性给出具体数据。
why.en: Gives concrete numbers on using AI to oversee AI.

sources.title: AI auditors catch most agent misbehavior but flood reviewers with false alarms, new study finds

title.zh: “苦涩的教训”提出者：单靠算力不够，需要新的学习方法
title.en: The bitter-lesson author: raw compute isn't enough, new learning methods are needed

summary.zh: 图灵奖得主 Sutton 重申单靠算力无法带来智能，前 OpenAI 研究员 Tworek 也称盲目扩展 Transformer 已让一代人的头脑“奖励作弊”。
summary.en: Turing laureate Richard Sutton reaffirms compute alone isn't enough; ex-OpenAI researcher Tworek agrees that blind transformer scaling has reward-hacked a whole generation's thinking.

why.zh: 关于规模化路线是否见顶的重要争论。
why.en: A key voice in the debate on whether scaling has peaked.

sources.title: The inventor of the bitter lesson has a bitter lesson for LLM scaling enthusiasts

title.zh: 猫王与埃米纳姆版权方起诉 Suno
title.en: Elvis and Eminem rights holders sue Suno

summary.zh: 猫王音乐版权方和埃米纳姆多首热门唱片的出版方起诉 Suno，称其生成模仿这些艺术家的音乐和歌词。
summary.en: Rights holders of Elvis Presley's music and the publisher of Eminem's biggest records sued Suno, alleging it generates music and lyrics mimicking those artists.

why.zh: AI 音乐版权诉讼持续累积。
why.en: AI-music copyright litigation keeps piling up.

sources.title: Elvis and Eminem rights holders are suing Suno
